R1.reason: Sweep pass stands. The shelf/partition mention in steps[8] ("You have everything you need to make a shelf and partition though if you would like") is optional.

R2.reason: All parts a step makes have a cut-list row or are cut by the step from listed stock (back plywood "1/4\" (27 1/2\" x 71\")" matches cutList[10]; door pieces steps[13-18] match cutList[11]).

R3.readerNote: Sweep candidate "Herringbone Pieces" rejected: steps[14] "I would cut 14 boards for each door of the exact same size ... 9 7/8\"" = 4 doors x 14 = 56 pieces at 9 7/8" (cutList[11]: qty 56, Kreg-corrected length 9.875); the steps call them "boards".
R3.search: other rows matched: top/side/bottom rails steps[0-3], stiles steps[4,5], plywood steps[6,7], support rails steps[8], door frames steps[11], door plywood steps[12], door stops steps[21]

R5.reason: R5 precondition not met: 8 stock types (2x2, 1x2, sheet-0.5, sheet-0.75, 0.25x1.75, 3.5x4.5, 1x4, sheet-0.25); steps not checked for per-part stock

R6.reason: Flagged "1 1/2" screw" in steps[4] rejected: 1 1/2" is the pocket-hole depth, the screws are the listed 2 1/2". But steps[22] uses 1 1/4" brad nails (and staples in steps[18,21,22]) and search of materials[].name for /brad|nail|staple/i finds none.

R8.reason: Frame (steps[0-5]) -> plywood panels and support rails (steps[6-8]) -> feet while inverted (steps[9]) -> door frames, panels, herringbone (steps[11-18]) -> finish -> hang doors, stops, back (steps[20-22]).

R9.reason: Settings stated for each thickness: "1 1/2\"" for 2x2s (steps[0]), "3/4\" thick so make sure and adjust your jig" (steps[6]), "3/4\" holes" (steps[7,8,11]), "pocket holes at 1/2\"" for the 1/2" door plywood (steps[12]).

R10.reason: Hinge and hinge-block positions (steps[20] "Depending on the hinges you use will determine how you do this next step"; "I used an inset concealed hinge so I has to add blocks on the inside") are not given in text. The only image for that step is on learn.kregtool.com (non-R2 host), which §5 does not allow fetching without Keagan's go-ahead, so it was not viewed. Everything else is given: front stile spacing 16 1/8" x4 openings and 25 1/2" (step-4 image), door frame 15 7/8" x 25 1/4" (step-11 image), door center "around 6 7/16\"" and 9 7/8" pieces (steps[13,14]).

R11.reason: Sweep pass stands (2 references, each in a step with its own image).

evidence.quote: I just used a small scrap piece of wood and glue and stapled it in the bottom of the buffet!!
I started gluing and stapling as I went after that!

R14.reason: (c) Staples are used in steps[18], [21], [22]; search of materials[].name for /staple/i found none. (a) passes: 4 openings x 16 1/8 + 3 front stiles x 1 1/2 = 64 1/2 + 4 1/2 = 69, equal to the bottom-rail row (69); doors 15 7/8 wide x 25 1/4 high fit 16 1/8 x 25 1/2 openings; 4 doors x 14 = 56 herringbone pieces. (b),(d) pass.

gaps.what: Four pulls are listed (qty 4) for a buffet with only doors; no step installs pulls or knobs (search of steps for /pull|knob|handle/i found none).

Area of 4 pieces = 4 x 12.875 x 22.25 = 1145.9 sq in against materials[2] "Plywood, 1/2\" Thick Quarter Sheet" (24 x 48 = 1152 if a quarter sheet is a quarter of 48 x 96, which section 9 does not define); only 3 such pieces can be laid out on 24 x 48 without a rip-and-rejoin. Not scored (sheet size not given).

gaps.what: Hinge blocks have no size, count or cut-list row; hinge type is left to the builder.
